**Finding: Compliant** (rule AUDIT, § 22).

§ 22 satisfies the preferred playbook position on all material terms:

| Term | Playbook preferred | § 22 |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | Once / 12 months | Once in any twelve-month period (§ 22.1) |
| Notice | 30 days' written | At least thirty days' prior written (§ 22.1) |
| Timing/manner | Business hours | Normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption (§ 22.1) |
| Auditor | Independent, confidentiality-bound | Same, off-site where practicable (§ 22.1) |
| Cost | Vendor's, unless underpayment >5% | Vendor's, unless underpayment >5% (§ 22.2) |
| System access | None | Vendor and auditor barred from direct system access, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material (§ 22.2) |

§ 22.3 gives us additional protection (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, shortfall payment resolves the issue). No other audit, inspection or verification right binding us exists elsewhere in the agreement. No redline proposed.
